subject.title: fix(qa): label static scorecard data as inventory

question: Should the shipped `openclaw qa coverage --json` field and diagnostic names remain compatible while inventory terminology is introduced?
rationale: The docs advertise machine-readable output and the old schema has shipped, so choosing an additive deprecation window versus an intentional breaking schema version requires explicit ownership of downstream automation impact.

options.title: Preserve compatibility
options.body: Add the inventory names while retaining deprecated old keys and values for a defined removal window, with compatibility tests.

options.title: Version the schema
options.body: Make the breaking rename explicit behind a new schema version and document how automation selects or migrates to it.

options.title: Accept the break
options.body: Treat QA JSON as unstable, land the rename, and clearly document that existing automation must update immediately.

recommendation.title: Preserve compatibility
recommendation.body: Add the inventory names while retaining deprecated old keys and values for a defined removal window, with compatibility tests.

likelyOwner.reason: The history identifies RomneyDa as the feature owner for both the evidence artifact and scorecard taxonomy surfaces.
